notes: Reviewed 2026-11-15: mRNA-seq arm of a ribosome-profiling protocol (fragmented, gel size-selected RNA); excluded by user decision. | 4 mRNA-seq candidates (ribosome profiling / DMS-seq samples not candidates). GSM2055255 uses a protocol where 'mRNA fragments were size selected via gel purification' without a size; labelled total_rnaseq as mRNA-seq but uncertain. Growth phase left out: only OD420 0.4 given (no OD600); 'exponentially growing' appears only in the DMS protocol. p-CTRL (empty control plasmid + IPTG) taken as control alongside plain WT; mini-ORF plasmids labelled heterologous_expression. treatment_protocol text (DMS, kasugamycin) refers to DMS-seq samples, not these mRNA-seq samples.
